entryPoints.name: actual zap_map lateral striking destruction of a canonical lowered drawbridge

functions.name: destroy_drawbridge
functions.sourceReview: Traced complete C dbridge.c:destroy_drawbridge (888–1020). JS preserves terrain/liquid and dry ice/room branches, source-ordered trap/engraving removal, rn2(6) chain count and per-chain x then y draws, canonical IRON_CHAIN creation, awaited scatter with SCATTER_MAY_HIT (0x06), vision updates, late wall occupant capture and resolution before bridge occupant capture, fatal-await returns, bridge damage/liquid effects, nokiller and Stronghold completion. The helper merges caller-selected RNG callbacks with canonical defaults.

callers.source: Real exported zap_map lateral WAN_STRIKING/SPE_FORCE_BOLT, find_drawbridge canonical position and originalType!=DRAWBRIDGE_UP branch. Primary actual initialized target test calls this production entry, not helper-only destroy; no public wand acquisition/history requirement.

pending: Source-parity runtime evidence only. No C gameplay recording, public C matching, public parity, source certification, aggregate suite, or checkpoint is claimed.
